picks.editorial_note: A £5M, Google-led international trial will use AI to adjust flight paths in real time and curb contrail-driven warming — a rare case of AI research moving directly into large-scale climate policy and industry practice.
picks.title: World’s first trial to test if flightpath changes could cut aviation’s climate impact

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab was selected to lead a DOE Genesis Mission effort applying AI to control particle accelerators, signaling a major federal bet on AI for next-generation scientific infrastructure.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: Decades of computational memory research at Penn have culminated in an implantable neurostimulation system that predicts and treats memory loss — a genuine translational breakthrough with direct clinical impact.
picks.title: A ‘breakthrough’ to restore memory | Penn Today

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins and Toyota Research Institute are pairing AI with automated high-throughput experiments to accelerate battery materials discovery, a concrete academia-industry push on a critical energy technology.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: A $9M NSF-funded iDLab, built with NCSA and UCLA, will unify browser-based access to national HPC centers in alignment with the national AI research resource (NAIRR) initiative — infrastructure that could broaden AI research access nationwide.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: Old Dominion's NASA-funded AI digital twin was put to an unplanned real-world test during actual Norfolk flooding, demonstrating rare validated performance of AI climate-resilience tools under live disaster conditions.
picks.title: When Norfolk Flooded, ODU Coastal Defense Research Faced an Unexpected Real-World Test

picks.editorial_note: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo are combining an AI drug-discovery platform with biomedical research capabilities in a new formal industry-academia cluster, advancing AI's role in pharmaceutical R&D.
picks.title: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo establish industry-academia Collaborative Research Cluster for AI-driven drug discovery | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College and Smith+Nephew launched a five-year center to translate computer-vision and AI research into surgical robotics, a substantial commercial-academic bet on AI-driven medical devices.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: SLAC developed a neural-network compression method that preserves scientific detail in massive datasets, directly addressing the looming data-storage crunch facing AI-driven experimental science.
picks.title: SLAC researchers develop AI-based tool to compress data without losing detail

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs often can't be traced to specific training data — has significant implications for ongoing AI copyright and provenance debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data
